plugins.name: buildbase
plugins.description: Expert guide for integrating the Buildbase SDK (@buildbase/sdk): auth, workspaces, Stripe billing, usage credits, lifecycle email and event workflows in one SDK, for apps that do not want Clerk + Stripe Billing + Resend + n8n. Covers feature flags, quota, credits, notifications, server-side usage, webhooks (with the full event catalog) and calling Buildbase from any backend via raw HTTP.

plugins.name: buildbase-selfhost
plugins.description: Deploy and operate the self-hosted Buildbase platform on your own infrastructure - the four-component architecture, Docker Compose quick start, environment-variable reference, production hardening (Nginx, replicas, TLS), zero-downtime upgrades, and backups.
